messages:

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick check-in + request to meet

Hi Rohan,

I wanted to flag a few persistent concerns I've observed over the past quarter around delivery and cross-team responsiveness. A couple of recent incidents stand out (long PR turnaround, a missed post-mortem action) and they have started to impact the team's sprint commitments.

This is an informal check-in — my goal is to work with you before anything formal happens. Can we meet tomorrow (Tue 11/3) for 30 minutes to walk through specific examples and set a short coaching plan with measurable expectations? I've attached a short set of notes to make the meeting more concrete.

If you prefer a different time, suggest a few slots.

Thanks,
Marcus

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Informal coaching plan (follow-up from today's 1:1)

Team — putting the summary from today's 1:1 in writing so we have clear expectations and checkpoints. Laura / Vivek: I want to keep you in the loop; this is still an informal coaching step (pre-PIP) unless the goals aren't met.

Summary of the conversation with Rohan (examples attached in CSV):
- Long PR turnaround: 4 PRs in October took >72 hours to get from Ready for review to merged; root causes include async scheduling and unclosed review comments.
- Missed post-mortem action: ownership on retention-fix follow-up dropped during the sprint transition.
- Cross-team clarity: some messages to product/infra lacked acceptance criteria which caused rework.

Proposed coaching plan (30 / 60-day checkpoints):
- 7 business-day PR SLA: respond to review requests within 48 hours; aim to merge within 7 business days unless blocker documented. Measured by Recent-PRs-202610.csv.
- Weekly sync 1:1 focused on blocker removal (15 min, Tuesdays) — Marcus/Rohan.
- Deliver two small scoped features/bugfixes in next sprint with clear acceptance criteria and a short demo at end of sprint.
- Post-mortem ownership: for any incident you touch, own the follow-up actions and close them in Jira within 10 business days.

Checkpoints / measurement:
- 30-day check (Mon, Dec 5): PR SLA, one completed demo, status of open post-mortem actions.
- 60-day check (Mon, Jan 4): sustained improvements; if goals are not met, we'll escalate to a formal PIP with HR.

Confidentiality: This stays within manager + HR circle for now.

Attachments: Recent-PRs-202610.csv, Coaching-Notes-Rohan-20261102.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus

Marcus / Rohan — thanks for the summary. A few HR notes and small clarifications from my side:

1) This is an informal coaching step (pre-PIP) and should be treated as an opportunity for improvement. We will document checkpoints and offer reasonable support (mentoring time, pairing, and prioritization help).
2) Confidentiality: limited to your manager, People Operations, and the manager's skip-level (Vivek) for oversight.
3) If milestones are missed at the 30-day or 60-day reviews, People Ops will coordinate the formal PIP process. That would include a written improvement plan, clearer success metrics, and HR oversight on cadence.

Action items for Rohan: please send your proposed changes to the acceptance criteria template and a short prioritization plan by EOD next Wednesday (11/10). We'll use that as input to the 30-day check.

Elaine (copied) — optional: if you have standard wording for pre-PIP coaching documentation we can attach to the file.

Laura Bennett
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
